name: Charger Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange wall-charger plug with lens eyes, grey prongs and a long black cable for a tail
entry: It plugs itself into walls and drinks electricity until it glows. Devices left near it charge in seconds, or burst.
how: Use a Charging Cable on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Zap Cannon in this form.
